notes: Pass 5 Lane 0: types registered before Pass 5 that the harvest did not list (ephemeral resources, list resources, functions, data.docker_registry_image_tags, data.docker_swarm_tokens, action.docker_system_prune) and the new docker_node resource (Q4). list_resource and function items have no outputs: the contract (V1/V2) covers the types that read or change Docker objects.

items.name: docker_node
items.summary: Labels, availability and role of an already-joined swarm node (NodeUpdate), without joining or leaving (Q4).

items.name: docker_system_prune
items.summary: Prune stopped containers, unused networks, dangling (or all unused) images, build cache and optionally volumes, like `docker system prune`.

items.name: docker_registry_image_tags
items.summary: Every tag of a repository, read straight from its registry (GET /v2/<name>/tags/list, paginated).

items.name: docker_swarm_tokens
items.summary: The swarm's worker and manager join tokens (SwarmInspect JoinTokens), stored in state as sensitive values.

items.name: docker_swarm_tokens
items.summary: The swarm's join tokens as ephemeral values, never written to plan or state.

items.name: docker_registry_token
items.summary: A short-lived registry bearer token from the registry's token service, never written to plan or state.

items.name: docker_exec_output
items.summary: Runs a command in a running container and returns its exit code, stdout and stderr as ephemeral values.

items.name: docker_container
items.summary: Lists existing objects as `docker_container` resources for `terraform query` and bulk import.

items.name: docker_image
items.summary: Lists existing objects as `docker_image` resources for `terraform query` and bulk import.

items.name: docker_network
items.summary: Lists existing objects as `docker_network` resources for `terraform query` and bulk import.

items.name: docker_volume

items.name: docker_swarm_node
items.summary: Lists existing objects as `docker_swarm_node` resources for `terraform query` and bulk import.

items.name: docker_service
items.summary: Lists existing objects as `docker_service` resources for `terraform query` and bulk import.

items.name: docker_secret
items.summary: Lists existing objects as `docker_secret` resources for `terraform query` and bulk import.

items.name: docker_config

items.name: parse_image_ref
items.summary: Splits an image reference into registry, repository, tag and digest.

items.name: image_ref
items.summary: Builds a fully qualified image reference from its parts.

items.name: port_spec
items.summary: Parses a `docker run -p` port spec into host_ip, host_port, container_port and protocol.

items.name: compose_env
items.summary: Turns a map of environment variables into sorted KEY=VALUE strings.
